descriptions.description: Gigartinaceae is a red algae family in the order Gigartinales.

Genera in the family Gigartinaceae include: Chondracanthus Kützing, 1843 Chondrus Stackhouse, 1797 Gigartina Stackhouse, 1809 Iridaea Bory de Saint-Vincent, 1826 Mazzaella G. De Toni, 1936 Ostiophyllum Kraft, 2003 Psilophycus W.A.Nelson, Leister & Hommersand, 2011 Rhodoglossum J.Agardh, 1876 Sarcothalia Kützing, 1849
